_disclaimer: Illustrative source registry for the ayurveda-oncology-support PROPOSAL only. Classifications below are first-pass triage based on source type and stated title; entries marked verification_status=pending_manual_verification have NOT had their full text checked against the tier-1/tier-2 bar described in evidence-and-safety.md and MUST NOT be cited for a patient-visible claim until that review happens. This file is not itself a clinical or legal determination.

tier_definitions.1: Current guidelines, government/regulator evidence reviews, authoritative oncology safety resources
tier_definitions.2: Systematic reviews and randomized human trials
tier_definitions.3: Nonrandomized human studies and single-arm pilots
tier_definitions.4: Narrative reviews, case reports, preclinical/animal work, classical texts, hospital service pages, clinic blogs, commercial pages, videos, testimonials -- context/discovery only, never sufficient alone for a patient efficacy claim
